title: Optimal approximation for submodular and supermodular optimization with bounded curvature
relevance: Provides (1-c/e)-approximation for submodular maximization with bounded curvature c. Theoretical foundation for greedy protein stability optimization when submodularity is approximate.
key_finding: First improvement over Conforti-Cornuejols (1984) greedy bound via continuous greedy and non-oblivious local search.

title: Greed Is Good: Near-Optimal Submodular Maximization via Greedy Optimization
relevance: REPEATEDGREEDY and SAMPLEGREEDY algorithms for non-monotone submodular maximization. If protein stability function is non-monotone (some mutations decrease stability), these algorithms still provide guarantees.
key_finding: Invoking classical greedy O(sqrt(k)) times achieves fastest deterministic algorithm for general submodular maximization under independence constraints.

title: A Refined Analysis of Submodular Greedy
relevance: Reduces enumeration requirement in tight (1-1/e)-approximation from subsets of size 3 to 2, making practical implementation more efficient.
key_finding: Refined greedy analysis reduces enumeration overhead while maintaining (1-1/e) approximation guarantee.
